targetTopLevelOwners..github: Exactly three canonical workflow entrypoints and GitHub metadata.
targetTopLevelOwners.adaptive-governance: Permanent adaptive product/build/delivery operating model and CURRENT projections. Retained as a distinct semantic owner; do not merge mechanically into operational governance.
targetTopLevelOwners.governance: Machine policy, registries, contracts, decisions, work-slice state and repository architecture rules.
targetTopLevelOwners.handoff: Single portable human resume entrypoint; projection of canonical machine state.
targetTopLevelOwners.internal: Cohesive production Go capability packages only. Extraction requires dependency boundary, behavior equivalence and package-aware tests.
targetTopLevelOwners.release: Current release manifests plus immutable version/history evidence. Historical shipped evidence never becomes current control.
targetTopLevelOwners.renderer: Current runtime UI assets with capability-oriented, version-neutral names; historical compatibility assets move to release/history or test fixtures.
targetTopLevelOwners.tests: Non-Go renderer/integration/acceptance/fixture evidence and tests that do not require private package-main access.
targetTopLevelOwners.tools: Reusable CI, release and developer tooling. No product runtime behavior owner.

governanceSubowners.governance/contracts: Long-lived human-readable operating and assurance contracts when moved in a later evidence-preserving wave.
governanceSubowners.governance/decisions: Point-in-time architecture/release decisions when moved in a later evidence-preserving wave.
governanceSubowners.governance/work-slices: Per-work-slice executable state, scope and closure evidence.

toolsSubowners.tools/ci: Canonical CI entrypoints and shared CI libraries; existing active paths may remain flat during this slice to avoid path churn.
toolsSubowners.tools/ci/gates: Preferred destination for newly migrated standalone root gates when no import/path compatibility requires the flat owner.
toolsSubowners.tools/ci/tests: Preferred destination for CI harness self-tests that are not product acceptance tests.
toolsSubowners.tools/release: Version-neutral release identity, qualification, certification and publication tooling.
toolsSubowners.tools/dev: Explicit manual/developer diagnostics only; never an automatic product runtime dependency.

testsSubowners.tests/integration: Cross-module or HTTP integration harnesses outside Go package-private tests.
testsSubowners.tests/fixtures: Stable non-secret fixtures shared by test harnesses.

versionNamedGoConvergence.rule: Rename in place to capability-oriented package-main names when the file is still a valid package-main owner. Extract to internal/<capability> only as a cohesive refactor; never create test-only production exports.

rendererConvergence.rule: Active runtime owners use capability-oriented names. Historical/version compatibility assets are not runtime owners and move to release/history or test fixtures after reference proof.

requiredProof: Qualified when slice closure is requested
